content.value: Keystones are build-changing passive flags. Their configured node tooltip should always be read before allocation. The combat engine currently recognizes the following effects.

Void Inoculation: incoming void damage is set to zero.
Avatar of Fire: converts half of final physical, cold, and lightning damage into fire, then removes non-fire outgoing damage, including void.
Resolute Technique: attacks bypass the target's evasion and raised-shield block; the wielder's exact configured trade-off is shown on its node.
Elemental Overload: a critical activates its timed elemental effect for 8 seconds.
Crimson Pact: disables maximum and current Energy Shield.
Iron Reflexes: adds evasion rating to armour for physical mitigation and prevents evading.
Zealot's Oath: life regeneration restores Energy Shield instead of health.
Ghost Reaver: disables normal Energy Shield recharge; use the node tooltip for its leech interaction.
Vaal Pact: disables life regeneration; use the node tooltip for its leech interaction.
Point Blank: modifies projectile damage according to travel distance.
A keystone's drawback can disable an entire defensive or recovery layer. Confirm the node tooltip and your alternate recovery plan before applying it.
